researchBasis: Standard right-handed kit: bass-drum pedal under right foot; hi-hat pedal under left foot.
Typical right-handed groove: right hand keeps hi-hat/ride/cymbal time, left hand handles snare backbeat.
Single-stroke rolls/fills use alternating R-L sticking as a baseline.
Phrase-aware sticking may change the starting hand so the required hand is free for the next cymbal/tom strike.
Simultaneous notes must never assign one limb to two instruments; SN+right-side tom naturally resolves SN=L and tom=R unless phrase evidence requires otherwise.
